statuses.name: Grappled
statuses.description: Held in a grapple — cannot move; attackers get +30% accuracy.

statuses.name: Force_Miss
statuses.description: The next attack made by this unit automatically misses.

statuses.name: Taunt
statuses.description: Compelled to target the unit that applied this taunt.

statuses.name: Demoralized
statuses.description: Spirit broken — -10 accuracy and -10 armor.

statuses.name: Disarmed
statuses.description: Weapon torn from grasp — cannot make weapon attacks. Can still cast spells and move.

statuses.name: Mindmucked
statuses.description: Mind clouded with filth — major penalty to Awareness and Focus.

statuses.name: Glass_Globe
statuses.description: Encased in a globe of conjured glass. Shatters on any damage received, dealing slashing AoE + guaranteed bleed to all within 2 tiles.

statuses.name: Crystal_Diadem
statuses.description: Crown of living crystal: major Focus and Awareness bonus. 50% chance to shatter and be lost whenever the wearer takes damage.

statuses.name: Strength_Plus_2
statuses.description: +2 Strength.

statuses.name: Finesse_Plus_2
statuses.description: +2 Finesse.

statuses.name: Focus_Plus_3
statuses.description: +3 Focus.

statuses.name: Awareness_Plus_3
statuses.description: +3 Awareness.

statuses.name: Constitution_Minus_2
statuses.description: -2 Constitution.

statuses.name: Focus_Minus_2
statuses.description: -2 Focus.

statuses.name: Initiative_Debuff
statuses.description: Reduced initiative, acts later in turn order.

statuses.name: Cleansed
statuses.description: All debuffs removed. Immune to new debuffs for 1 turn.

statuses.name: Mental_Immunity
statuses.description: Immune to charm, fear, and confusion effects.

statuses.name: Fire_Vulnerable_50
statuses.description: 50% extra damage from fire attacks.

statuses.name: Marked_for_Death
statuses.description: Marked target takes 25% more damage and is more vulnerable to critical hits.

statuses.name: Rainbow_Cloak
statuses.description: Shimmering cloak of prismatic light grants resistance to all elements and a dodge bonus.

statuses.name: Pinned
statuses._note: Applied by Trishula on crit. Cannot move, can still act.

statuses.name: Subjugated
statuses._note: Applied by Phurba throw on failed Focus save (DC 16). Cannot move or attack, but can still cast spells.

statuses.name: Riposte_Ready
statuses._comment: Marker from the Riposte perk — damage/stamina consumption not yet wired in attack_unit

statuses.name: Reflect
statuses._comment: Marker from Lady of the Turquoise Mirror mantra — reflect resolution not yet wired

statuses.name: Radiance
statuses.description: A standing light that mends companions and dazzles whoever comes close.

statuses.name: Radiant_Visage
statuses.description: The caster's face shines; those near it are hard to frighten or deceive.

statuses.name: Anchored
statuses.description: Pinned to this plane. Cannot blink, teleport, swap or be scattered — though a shove still works, because being nailed to the world does not make you heavy.

statuses.name: Inner_Flame
statuses.description: Inner heat. Fire and water both find less purchase, and whoever strikes you in close catches light.

statuses.name: Shining_Mirage
statuses.description: The caster's outline swims and doubles. Those who look at it lose track of themselves — until they learn to look past it.

statuses.name: Time_Stopped
statuses.description: Held outside the moment. Not stunned, not held — simply not yet. Nothing shakes this off, because there is no time in which to do so.

statuses.name: Disoriented
statuses.description: Ears ringing, footing uncertain. Everything is a little harder for a moment.

statuses.name: Lava_Walking
statuses.description: The ground runs molten and does not care. Fire has no mobility magic of its own; this is the whole of it.

statuses.name: Marshtread
statuses.description: Ground that gives way holds you up. Bog and deep snow are the same problem.

statuses.name: Camels_Blessing
statuses.description: Loose burning ground carries you as a road would.

statuses.name: Following_Wind
statuses.description: The air moves with the party rather than against it. Ground goes by faster.

statuses.name: Rahulas_Cloak
statuses.description: Nothing on the road notices the party pass. Rāhu swallows the sun and is not observed doing it.
